summary: Generation closure, closing-connection fence (D7), and O(1) shard detach fence (D9) across the coordinator, I/O task, and delivery shard (--delivery-shards K >= 1, ADR 0066). Proves that a shard cannot write to a generation once the coordinator marks ConnCore::closing, that DeliveryShardWorker::finish_detaches signals completion only once I/O queues, the O(1) terminal_by_conn counter, and in-flight FinishDelivery/PreparePubrel work have all settled, and that a replacement generation never overlaps an un-detached generation. Refutes three mutants removing each fence.
not_replayed: All safety invariants and mutant counterexamples are replayed by deterministic unit tests in delivery_shard/fence_tests.rs.
